generate_tutorials_from_notebooks: generate HTML, JS, ipynb, and py tutorial files from Jupyter notebooks for a Docusaurus site
run_gen_tutorials: run gen_tutorials to convert all notebooks listed in tutorials.json into website tutorial files
convert_notebook_to_html: convert a Jupyter notebook to HTML using nbconvert and extract the notebook container div with BeautifulSoup
generate_tutorial_js_page: generate a React JS tutorial page file from the TEMPLATE string for a given tutorial ID
export_notebook_to_python: export a Jupyter notebook to a standalone Python script using nbconvert ScriptExporter
